Fully digital brokerage -- markets an instant online quote and purchase flow in about 3 minutes, no broker call typically required. Backed by a joint venture between Achmea and Fairfax Financial; the exact underwriting legal entity was not confirmed from public research, so capture whatever the actual quote/disclosure page names. quote_url updated to the real form (a different subdomain, app.onlia.ca, behind a client-side route) -- www.onlia.ca/car-insurance/quote is only a marketing landing page. Confirmed live: the personal-info step is a Typeform-style form (Enter to advance, not a visible Continue button), its address field is Canada Post's AddressComplete widget, its start-date field is an ngx-bootstrap calendar, and its Continue/"Start My Quote" button is gated behind a required Terms of Use/Privacy Policy checkbox that automation must never check -- see src/quote_agent/agents/sites/onlia.py, which automates everything up to that checkpoint and always ends in manual_handoff there. Also confirmed live: Onlia's invisible reCAPTCHA v3 fails headless Chromium's fingerprint (a real "Captcha validation failed" page, correctly caught as CaptchaDetected) -- this flow only gets past it in headed mode.

Independent broker representing 50+ insurers, including Gore Mutual -- one of the few practical paths to a mutual, since Gore Mutual has no direct consumer quote page of its own (confirmed via research: Gore Mutual is broker-only). Ontario's Insurance Act requires a broker to disclose its full carrier list and all quote outcomes obtained for the applicant on request -- ask for the complete list, not just the first quote returned.
